title: Localized tensor comparison shift component
statement: Under the hypotheses of localizedTensorComparisonProperty_shift, for a fixed cochain representative U of X[n], a K-flatness proof for U, a base-derived tensor cohomology model mU of U tensor Q, and a degree i, the localized comparison composite for U in degree i is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0DJA(1), shift transport for one representative, model and degree

proof.text: Apply DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso(-n), shift the representative isomorphism Q(U) ~= X[n] by -n and cancel n+(-n) to prove that U[-n] represents X. For an acyclic test V, mapBifunctorShift₂Iso identifies V tensor U[-n] with (V tensor U)[-n]; the homology shift isomorphism transports the degreewise exactness supplied by hK. Thus U[-n] is K-flat.

Apply the inverse-shift conjugacy square to the supplied mU and degree i. Obtain mV, eS, eT and the equality of comparison arrows. Apply hX to the now verified representative U[-n], its K-flatness, mV and degree i+n. Rewrite the required arrow using the conjugacy equality; it is a composite of eS.inv, this invertible arrow and eT.hom. IsIso is closed under composition.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJA(1), inverse-shift representative and explicit conjugacy square

mathlib_searches.results: No single theorem gives the specialized comparison transport.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_shift_component
    (X : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hX : localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t X) (n : ℤ)
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hU : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ X⟦n⟧))
    (hK : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)
